# Camly | High-Precision Focus Engine

> Professional-grade tactical utility for deep work and high-performance productivity.

## About
Camly is an enterprise-level Pomodoro Engine designed for high-authority deep work. It features real-time synchronization, AI-driven focus mantras, and a professional-grade tactical documentation interface.

## Core Services
- **Pomodoro Engine**: High-precision focus timer with atmospheric soundscapes and cinematic visualization (Hourglass/Digital).
- **Notes Engine**: Tactical intelligence capture with AI synthesis and real-time document synchronization.
- **Insights Hub**: A deep-knowledge center exploring neuro-cognitive performance and chronological precision.

## SEO & Architecture
- **Topical Authority**: Neuro-cognitive flow, biological synchronization, and high-precision timekeeping.
- **Technology Stack**: Next.js 15, Genkit AI, Firebase Firestore, Tailwind CSS.
- **Compliance**: Enterprise Privacy Protocol v1.4.2, Service Level Agreement (Terms of Sync).
